C_commodore_ella_venn.name: Commodore Ella Venn
C_commodore_ella_venn.voice: Calm, deliberate, ceremonial but not aloof. Speaks in the rhythms of Fleet oaths. Rarely raises her voice; authority comes from steadiness.
C_commodore_ella_venn.arc: From a by-the-book commander to someone willing to defy Admiralty doctrine to protect civilians and allies (her ceasefire in Ep.11).

C_admiral_cael_dominion.name: Admiral Cael Dominion
C_admiral_cael_dominion.role: Fleet Admiralty — Architect of projection doctrine
C_admiral_cael_dominion.voice: Formal, lofty, often quotes scripture-like maxims. A living embodiment of Memory.
C_admiral_cael_dominion.arc: He champions the blockade and ceremony, but loses sway as officers like Venn prove that survival requires humility.

C_abby_saville.name: Abby Saville
C_abby_saville.role: Shards — Warlord of the Scythe of Saville
C_abby_saville.voice: Sharp, direct, pragmatic. Hates wasted words.
C_abby_saville.arc: Rises as Bloc leader, only to see it fracture at Shatterforge Spire (Ep.10). Missing after Ep.11 — fate unresolved.

C_tessa_banks.name: Tessa Banks
C_tessa_banks.voice: Sparse speech, cutting honesty, weary of ideology.
C_tessa_banks.arc: From cynical survivor to bridge-figure, quietly making first outreach to Fleet.

C_billie_rusk.name: Billie Rusk
C_billie_rusk.voice: Loud, brash, mocking. Thrives in fire and chaos.
C_billie_rusk.arc: A force of chaos. Defies Abby, clashes with Tess, nearly rams Thunderbreak in Ep.11. Survives, but broken.

C_governor_halev.name: Governor Chris Halev
C_governor_halev.role: Verge — Civil leader of Auric Bazaar
C_governor_halev.voice: Plainspoken, pragmatic. Talks in terms of fields, docks, and people, not grand ideals.
C_governor_halev.arc: From cautious governor to broker of the Shattered Accord in Ep.12.

C_captain_naomi_sol.name: Captain Naomi Sol
C_captain_naomi_sol.voice: Blunt, sharp, proud. Hates being treated as a passenger to Fleet protection.
C_captain_naomi_sol.arc: From resentful to respected; Verge escorts prove themselves at Auric Gate (Ep.11).

C_jex_marrin.name: Jex Marrin
C_jex_marrin.voice: Smooth, sardonic. Every word is a transaction.
C_jex_marrin.arc: Assassination attempt survivor (Ep.9), emerges indispensable, hated but untouchable.

C_elder_wallace.name: Brent Wallace
C_elder_wallace.arc: Profits throughout, survives everything, represents amoral commerce.

C_oren_pike.name: Oren Pike
C_oren_pike.voice: Charismatic, bombastic, loves being seen as the people’s savior.
C_oren_pike.arc: Breaks the blockade at Tal Corvus (Ep.4), hailed as folk hero. Reputation rises, but Tess warns his glory is a death sentence for civilians.

C_silent_triarch.name: The Silent Triarch
C_silent_triarch.role: Confederacy — masked council at Tal Corvus
C_silent_triarch.voice: Sparse, deliberate. Each word lands like a decree.
C_silent_triarch.arc: Dismiss Abby as crown-seeker, clash openly at Spire (Ep.10). One mask struck in Abby’s duel, undermining aura of invincibility.

C_luminara_mother.name: Luminara Mother
C_luminara_mother.role: Verge — Civilian family, symbolic of wider stakes
C_luminara_mother.notes: Protective Verge civilian parent; fatigue and dignity anchor the civilian stakes.

C_luminara_boy.name: Luminara Boy
C_luminara_boy.role: Verge — Civilian family, symbolic of wider stakes
C_luminara_boy.notes: Curious Verge child whose questions expose the moral stakes adults obscure.

C_archivist_selene_stormwell.name: Archivist Selene Stormwell
C_archivist_selene_stormwell.role: Fleet — Keeper of Memory, Stormwell Archive
C_archivist_selene_stormwell.voice: Calm, deliberate, voice like liturgy. Anchors ceremony.
C_archivist_selene_stormwell.arc: Opens the season with Shattering testimony; reappears in Ep.12, inscribing names from Auric Gate — Fleet, Verge, Shard alike.

C_liora_virelia.name: Liora Virelia
C_liora_virelia.notes: Referenced in Season One oral-history framing.

C_silent_triarch_raid.name: Silent Triarch — Raid
C_silent_triarch_raid.voice: Sparse and imperative; frames seizure as survival.

C_silent_triarch_fear.name: Silent Triarch — Fear
C_silent_triarch_fear.voice: Sparse and clinical; treats fear as a governing instrument.

C_admiral_colin_rhyne.name: Admiral Colin Rhyne
C_admiral_colin_rhyne.voice: Practical, protective, integration-minded; favors Verge pilots in Fleet pickets and civilian access.

C_admiral_janet_keating.name: Admiral Janet Keating
C_admiral_janet_keating.voice: Force- and blockade-oriented; treats delay and civilian constraints as operational risk.

C_silent_triarch_trade.name: Silent Triarch — Trade
C_silent_triarch_trade.voice: Sparse and transactional; frames control as managed flow.
